'''3D1''' was a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gavos]] and was part of the [[New Droids' Rights Movement]], a group of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that was focused on spreading violent rebellion against [[Species/Legends|organic]] life forms throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
